_original_lore: The life cycle of a mushroom starts
with the spore, which germs and
fruit bodies into a mature mushroom,
name: 蘑菇孢子

source: The life cycle of a mushroom starts
with the spore, which germs and
fruit bodies into a mature mushroom,
loreParagraphs.translation: 蘑菇的生命周期始于孢子,孢子发芽后成为菌丝体,菌丝体发育出子实体长成成熟的蘑菇,而成熟的蘑菇会释放孢子.
